mechanism: Sodium valproate may increase dapagliflozin exposure through inhibition of glucuronidation and potential displacement from protein binding, while dapagliflozin use carries independent risk of diabetic ketoacidosis which valproate does not mitigate.
action: Monitor blood glucose control and ketone levels; consider alternative antiepileptic if possible; counsel on DKA symptoms; no dose adjustment typically required but increased vigilance warranted.
